title: Page 3
slug: 娇妃要和离-风光-娘子人如其名温柔了时光款款向我走来-欸娘子别动手本郡王真不是故意成亲就失忆-谁能比她温柔倒楣郡王夫君成
content_zh:
不过这晋王次子可就没有这种和稀泥的心思，崔仲衡对崔静言又忌惮又巴结，皆是因崔静言有着商业上的惊人天赋，自他开始打理晋王府的产业，到现在资产直接翻了三倍，可说王府里一切花费的都是经由崔静言的手赚来的。
所以崔静言与崔承恩，一个有钱一个有权，牢牢的掌握住了王府的权力。
兼之崔静言与当今圣上一起长大，两人交情之好只差没同穿一条裤子，他身为郡王，在户部也有挂着一个给事中的职衔，这个职衔品级不高，但是有着谏言、监察户部之责，可直接上达天听，非皇帝心腹不可为。
就这一点，崔静言在京城的声名比崔仲衡响亮许多。
相形之下，晋王的三个儿子里崔仲衡就显得黯淡无光，既非世子也未领官职。要不是崔承恩身体不好，时常需要崔仲衡出面代行世子之事，他这个庆成郡王很可能在京城里寂寂无名，提到名字都不会有人想起来。
眼下他一眼看出崔静言有多么不喜温柔，便顺水推舟说道：「大哥，话不能这么说，现在三弟可是不认这桩婚事，而且两人也还没拜堂，硬要说是过门了也说不过去。」
姜氏见丈夫发话，也连忙附和道：「是呢是呢！何况三弟如今似乎很是不喜这温……呃，温姑娘，我们硬要留人下来，万一加重了三弟的伤势……」
她可是恨不得搅黄了这桩婚事，崔静言与皇帝交好，又控制着王府的所有银钱，还有威武侯府做亲家，本以为他们二房在这王府里没戏唱了，以后只能仰人鼻息过日子，但现在有机会改变，自然打蛇随棍上，她可不愿意窝囊过一辈子。
只是崔仲衡夫妻这番话激起了晋王的不满，虽然没拜堂，但崔静言已亲自去迎娶，现在不认帐怎么也说不过去，还会大大得罪威武侯府，这么傻的事，怎么他这蠢笨的二儿子会想不到？
还不是忌妒惹的！谁叫姜氏只是个工部五品郎中之女，当初也不知两人如何勾搭上，不得不娶进门来，现在看崔静言娶了威武侯之女，才觉得妻子娘家势弱。
晋王对二儿子除了怒其不争之外，也分外瞧不起小家子气的姜氏，只是平时不显，但到了这个时候，所有的不满就一次爆发出来。
他一个拍桌，瞪向崔仲衡夫妻。「你们两个给本王闭嘴！这桩婚事，静言不认本王认！静言，不说你已亲去侯府将温柔迎了回来，有诸多人证，就是你遇刺时她不顾自身安危救了你，还弄得自己也受了伤，你就不该说那些话！」
「我……」崔静言心头一惊，又仔仔细细看了温柔，才发现她身上血迹斑斑，只是都被嫁衣的大红掩饰住了，那对她所有反感的言语一时竟再说不出口。
瞧他服了软，晋王心里好受了一些，直接拍板定案。「从今以后，温柔就是我们晋王府过了门的三媳妇，没拜堂又如何？等静言身体好些再补上仪式就好了！」
尤其，他还特别剐了二儿子以及二媳妇一眼，看得他们寒气直冒，不敢再说一句挑拨的话。
晋王妃在心中喟叹，三个儿子都是她心头肉，也不好偏袒谁，便又出来打了圆场。「好了好了，今天好好的大喜事，可别动了气，就当那些坏事都过去了。静言刚醒过来，李太医说让他好好休息，我们都出去，留温柔在这里陪他吧。」
这么说，自是想让老三两口子多处处，培养一点感情。她一脸和善地看向温柔。「温柔，你……你可以吗？」
温柔肯定地点头。「我可以的，爹，娘。」
在王府外，晋王夫妇自是摆足了架子，三个儿子都是尊称他们为父王、母妃，但平素王府内的日常生活与一般百姓无异，称呼爹娘兄嫂等等。
这会儿听温柔爹娘喊得顺口，一点都不见外，晋王妃也乐了，笑容终是扩大了些。「好好好，等会儿我会让下人来替你上药，你也找机会休息一下，琐事可以交代下去，切莫再动到伤口，明日一早的敬茶就免了吧。」

温柔点了点头，恭送晋王夫妇及其他人离开了房间，也让下人都退出房门外候着，自己才又回到崔静言床边。
父母兄嫂全离开了，崔静言也不再掩饰自己的不悦，板着脸瞪向温柔，「你有什么企图？」
要是换了个人这么不客气，温柔早就一拳过去，不过眼前这男人是她自己选的，现在还撞坏了脑袋，她有什么好计较的？所以她听而不闻一切他的恶声恶气，只是再一次确认道：「你当真少了这三年的记忆？」
「我不知道。」崔静言也很无奈，口气显得更差了。「我只知道，我不可能会娶你。爹虽然承认你过了门，但我不喜欢你，你在我身边待着也是浪费青春。改明儿个这婚事的风声过了，你可以主动求去，我绝对不为难你。」
这话够伤人了，但温柔熟知他的性格，两人在相爱的日子里，唇枪舌战也不是一次两次，自然对这样的话有相当的抵抗力。
「你听好了。」
她欺上前，与他四目相对，崔静言本能的往后退了些，背却已经碰到了床头。她一手抵着墙，脸离他极近，也就是这样，他看清了她眼中有着难以言喻的坚决，以及神采飞扬的自信。
「崔静言，我能让你爱上我一次，就能让你爱上我第二次，你等着看吧！」
崔静言除了后脑的肿包，身上没有其他的伤口，能吃能睡，要不是失去了记忆，伤势比中了几刀的温柔都要轻得多。
温柔也不愧是将门虎女，几道刀伤没有丝毫减损她的精神，包紮好后便像常人一般行止无异，还坚持与崔静言同房，替他净脸换衣、梳头结髻，除了不能圆房，她做足了妻子该做的事，偏偏他文弱体虚，敌不过她的武力，只能黑着脸默默就范。
真别说，她的动作虽不细致，力道却控制得极好，似乎也很清楚他的作息习惯，连穿衣要从右手开始、梳头喜欢用小篦子这样的琐事，她问都不问信手拈来，完全不会弄得他不舒服，若是闭上眼不看，这样的服侍挺令人享受的。
崔静言由一开始的抗拒到后来的弃守，也让温柔相信他即使一时无法接受两人亲事，待他慢慢想起来，很快两人就会恢复以往的亲密。因此即便他与她说话总是冷淡，面色不豫，她也视而不见，居然也与他安然相处下来。
约莫半个月之后，晋王见三儿子身体无事，新婚夫妻之间除了冷淡些，好像也没什么冲突，便让他们在宗祠补了拜堂，放心的回封地太原去了。
当然，崔静言是僵着脸被抬去的，心中的不情愿及反抗无须多言。
京城晋王府的中馈一向在柳氏手上，柳氏出身毅国公府，是标准的大家闺秀，理家之事从小有宫中退下的嬷嬷教导，因此不管晋王夫妇在不在京，王府都是由她管着，过了崔静言成亲时那一阵忙乱后，府里很快就恢复了井井有条。
最不能适应王府生活的约莫是刚进门的宁化郡王妃温柔了。
她是武将之女，自小在古北口那样苍凉却开阔的地方成长，对于京中贵女那一套规矩虽是学过却并未实践，性格举止很是跳脱。
十五岁那年回京，她未出阁前，白日会在威武侯府中的演武场练练武射射箭，或是至京郊庄子骑马，但如今这晋王府里雕梁画栋、假山流水花木扶疏，哪里有地方让她练武骑马？
content_en:
However, the second son of Prince Jin did not have such conciliatory thoughts. Cui Zhongheng was jealous and fawning over Cui Jingyan, all because Cui Jingyan had an amazing talent in business. Since he started taking care of the property of Prince Jin's Palace, his assets have tripled. It can be said that everything spent in the Palace was earned by Cui Jingyan's hands.
Therefore, Cui Jingyan and Cui Chengen, one rich and the other powerful, firmly held the power of the palace.
In addition, Cui Jingyan and the current emperor grew up together. The only difference between the two of them being close friends is that they don't wear the same pair of trousers. As the king of the county, he also has a job title in the Ministry of Household Affairs. This title is not high-level, but he has the responsibility of admonishing and supervising the Ministry of Household Affairs. He can go directly to Heaven, and only the emperor's confidants can do it.
On this point, Cui Jingyan's reputation in the capital is much louder than Cui Zhongheng's.
In comparison, among the three sons of King Jin, Cui Zhongheng looked dim. He was neither the crown prince nor an official. If it weren't for Cui Chengen's poor health and Cui Zhongheng's frequent need to step in to act as the crown prince, he, the Prince of Qingcheng County, would probably be unknown in the capital, and no one would even think of him when his name was mentioned.
Now he could see at a glance how much Cui Jingyan didn't like gentleness, so he followed suit and said, "Brother, you can't say that. Now the third brother doesn't recognize the marriage, and the two of them haven't married yet, so it can't be justified to say that they are married."
When Mrs. Jiang saw her husband speaking, she quickly echoed: "Yes, yes! Besides, the third brother seems to dislike Wen very much now... uh, Miss Wen, we insist on keeping someone here, in case the injury of the third brother is aggravated..."
She really wanted to mess up the marriage. Cui Jingyan was on good terms with the emperor, and controlled all the money in the palace, as well as the Marquis Weiwu's palace as her in-laws. She thought that their second wife would have no chance in the palace and would have to live on their own. But now that there was a chance to change, she naturally followed the stick. She was not willing to live a useless life.
It was just the words of Cui Zhongheng and his wife that aroused the dissatisfaction of King Jin. Although Cui Jingyan did not go to court, Cui Jingyan had gone to marry him in person. It was unjustifiable not to admit the debt now, and it would also greatly offend the Weiwu Marquis Mansion. How could his stupid second son not think of such a stupid thing?
It’s not because of jealousy! Who said that Mrs. Jiang was just the daughter of a fifth-grade doctor from the Ministry of Industry? She didn't know how the two hooked up in the first place, so they had to marry her. Now that Cui Jingyan married the daughter of Marquis Weiwu, she felt that her natal family was weak.
In addition to being angry with his second son for not fighting, the King of Jin also looked down upon the small-minded Jiang family. He usually didn't show it, but at this time, all his dissatisfaction burst out at once.
He slapped the table and glared at Cui Zhongheng and his wife. "Shut up, you two! I don't acknowledge Jingyan about this marriage! Jingyan, don't tell me that you went to the Marquis' Mansion to bring Wenwen back in person. There are many witnesses who testified that when you were assassinated, she saved you regardless of her own safety and even got herself injured. You shouldn't have said those words!"
"I..." Cui Jingyan was startled, and after taking a closer look at Wen Wen, she realized that her body was covered in blood, but it was covered up by the red color of her wedding dress. All the disgusting words towards her could not be uttered for a moment.
Seeing that he had surrendered, King Jin felt better and made a decision directly. "From now on, Wen Wen is the third daughter-in-law of our Prince Jin's palace. So what if we don't have a wedding ceremony? Just wait until Jingyan's health gets better and then we can make up for the ceremony!"
In particular, he gave his second son and second wife a special look, which made them chill and dare not say another provocative word.
Princess Jin sighed in her heart that her three sons were all her favorites and it was hard to favor anyone, so she went out to smooth things over again. "Okay, okay, today is a great happy event, don't get angry, just treat all the bad things as past. Jingyan just woke up, Doctor Li said to let him have a good rest, let's all go out, and leave Wenrou here to accompany him."
That said, I want the third child and his wife to have sex more often., develop some feelings. She looked at Wen Wen with a kind face. "Gentle, can you...can you?"
Gentle nodded affirmatively. "I can do it, dad, mom."
Outside the palace, Prince Jin and his wife were very arrogant, and their three sons all respectfully called them father and mother, and concubine. However, daily life in the palace was no different from ordinary people, calling them father, mother, brother, sister-in-law, etc.
Now hearing that Wen Wen's father and mother were shouting smoothly and not showing any signs of surprise, Princess Jin was also happy, and her smile finally widened a little. "Okay, okay, I'll have my servants come to apply medicine for you later. You should also find a chance to rest. You can continue with the trivial matters. Don't touch the wound again. I'll skip the tea ceremony tomorrow morning."
Wen Wen nodded, respectfully sent Prince Jin and his wife and others out of the room, and asked the servants to exit the room and wait outside, before returning to Cui Jingyan's bedside.
Her parents, brothers and sister-in-law all left, and Cui Jingyan no longer concealed her displeasure and glared at Wen Wen with a straight face, "What are your intentions?"
If someone else was so rude, Wen Wenwen would have punched him, but she chose the man in front of her, and now he broke his head. What should she care about? So she ignored all his bad words and just confirmed once again: "Have you really lost the memory of these three years?"
"I don't know." Cui Jingyan was also helpless and her tone became even worse. "I only know that there is no way I will marry you. Although dad admits that you are married, I don't like you. It's a waste of your youth to stay by my side. Tomorrow, when the news of the marriage has passed, you can take the initiative to ask for it, and I will never embarrass you."
These words were hurtful enough, but Wen Wen knew his character well. During the days when the two were in love, they had verbal quarrels not once or twice, so they were naturally quite resistant to such words.
"Listen carefully."
She stepped forward and met his eyes. Cui Jingyan instinctively stepped back, but her back had already touched the head of the bed. She put one hand against the wall and her face was very close to his. In this way, he could clearly see the indescribable determination in her eyes and the high-spirited confidence.
"Cui Jingyan, I can make you fall in love with me once, and I can make you fall in love with me a second time. Just wait and see!"
Except for the swelling on the back of her head, Cui Jingyan had no other wounds on her body. She could eat and sleep. If she hadn't lost her memory, her injuries would have been much less serious than Wen Wenwen, who had been stabbed several times.
Gentle is worthy of being a general. A few stab wounds did not dampen her spirit at all. After being bandaged, she behaved like a normal person. She also insisted on sleeping with Cui Jingyan, cleaning his face, changing clothes, and combing his hair into a bun. Except that she could not consummate the marriage, she did everything a wife should do. However, he was weak and weak, and could not stand up to her force, so she could only submit silently with a dark face.
Needless to say, although her movements were not meticulous, her strength was extremely well controlled, and she seemed to know his daily habits very well. Even trivial matters such as starting with the right hand when getting dressed, and preferring to use a small comb for combing hair, she did it without asking, and would not make him uncomfortable at all. If you close your eyes, this kind of service is quite enjoyable.
Cui Jingyan's resistance from the beginning to his abandonment made Wenwen believe that even if he could not accept the marriage between the two for a while, when he slowly thought about it, the two would soon regain their previous closeness. Therefore, even though he always spoke coldly to her and looked hesitant, she turned a blind eye and actually got along with him peacefully.
About half a month later, King Jin saw that his third son was in good health, and there seemed to be no conflicts between the newlyweds except for being a little cold, so he asked them to repair the worship hall in the ancestral hall and returned to Taiyuan, his fiefdom, with peace of mind.
Of course, Cui Jingyan was carried away with a stiff face, and there was no need to say anything about her reluctance and resistance.
The middle child of Prince Jin's palace in the capital has always been in the hands of the Liu family. She was born in Duke Yi's palace and is a standard lady. She has been taught by her grandmother who retired from the palace since she was a child. Therefore, regardless of whether Prince Jin and his wife are in the capital or not, she is in charge of the palace.After getting rid of the chaos when Cui Jingyan got married, the house quickly returned to order.
The one who is least able to adapt to life in the palace is the gentle princess of Ninghua County who has just entered the house.
She is the daughter of a military commander. She grew up in a desolate but open place like Gubeikou. Although she has learned the rules of a noble lady in the capital, she has not practiced them. Her personality and behavior are very out of touch.
When she returned to Beijing when she was fifteen years old, before she left the palace, she would practice martial arts and archery in the martial arts field in the Weiwu Marquis' mansion during the day, or go to Zhuangzi on the outskirts of Beijing to ride horses. But now, in the Jin Prince's palace, where there are carved beams and painted buildings, rockeries, flowing water, flowers and trees, where is there a place for her to practice martial arts and horseback riding?
